name: T4DM
aliases: Testosterone for the Prevention of Type 2 Diabetes
question: Does testosterone undecanoate added to a lifestyle programme prevent or revert diabetes-range glucose values in men at high metabolic risk?

arms.label: Intramuscular testosterone undecanoate plus lifestyle programme

design.population: Men aged 50–74 years with waist circumference ≥95 cm, testosterone ≤14.0 nmol/L without pathological hypogonadism, and two-hour OGTT glucose 7.8–11.0 mmol/L or newly diagnosed diabetes with glucose ≤15.0 mmol/L.
design.description: Six-center, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3b randomized trial

verdictNote: Both prespecified 2-year glucose outcomes favored testosterone; hematocrit triggers were frequent.
takeaway: In T4DM, intramuscular testosterone undecanoate plus a lifestyle programme reduced diabetes-range 2-hour glucose at 2 years and improved mean 2-hour glucose versus placebo plus the same programme; hematocrit above 54% triggered safety review more often with testosterone.

reports.label: Two-year primary report
reports.dateLocator: University of Adelaide release dated 2020-12-16 states publication online that day
reports.citation: Wittert G, Bracken K, Robledo KP, et al. "Testosterone treatment to prevent or revert type 2 diabetes in men enrolled in a lifestyle programme (T4DM): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 2-year, phase 3b trial." *Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol.* 2021;9(1):32-45. doi:10.1016/S2213-8587(20)30367-3

results.measure: 2-hour glucose ≥11.1 mmol/L at 2 years, among those with available OGTT data
results.note: Intention-to-treat analysis; endpoint data available for 856 of 1,007 randomized men.

results.measure: Mean change from baseline at 2 years; between-arm mean difference in mmol/L

harms.label: Prespecified serious adverse events
harms.note: Two deaths occurred in each randomized group.

delivery.label: Injection schedule
delivery.value: Testosterone undecanoate 1,000 mg intramuscularly or placebo at baseline, 6 weeks, then every 3 months for 2 years; both groups enrolled in a lifestyle programme.

reports.label: Postrandomization survey
reports.citation: Handelsman DJ, Grossmann M, Yeap BB, et al. "Long-term Outcomes of Testosterone Treatment in Men: A T4DM Postrandomization Observational Follow-up Study." *J Clin Endocrinol Metab.* 2024;109(1):e25-e31. doi:10.1210/clinem/dgad485
reports.followUp: Median 5.1 years since last injection; 599/1,007 completed surveys

results.endpoint: Self-reported new diabetes after trial treatment
results.note: No between-group difference reported; survey response was 316/504 versus 283/503, and diabetes outcome counts were absent from the abstract.

harms.label: New sleep apnea diagnosis during randomized treatment, self-reported at survey
harms.note: P=0.03; the abstract gives no event counts.

results.note: A 2-point increase defined clinically significant improvement in the exploratory categorical analysis; no multiplicity adjustment was prespecified.

delivery.locator: PDF pp e2159–e2160, Results and corrected Table 1
